description: The record of layer 5 for a feature: what is measured, by which scorers and judge, how changes are gated, what traces contain and how production feeds back.
The implementable part: dataset and critical cases, scorers, judge, gate thresholds and cost, tracing settings, review sampling and drift alerts.
The pass-rate movement between runs of the same version; the gate's tolerance must sit above it.
The largest quality decrease the product tolerates; the gate's tolerance must sit at or below it.
How many traces people can label per period. Random and triggered samples together must fit within it.
